name: Victoria
summary: A British blue ensign with the Southern Cross in white stars, topped by the St Edward's Crown, in the fly.
origin: The colony of Victoria first used the Southern Cross on its blue ensign in 1870. A crown was added in 1877, changed to the Tudor crown in 1901 and to the St Edward's Crown in 1953 after Queen Elizabeth II's accession.

symbols.name: Southern Cross
symbols.description: Five white stars of differing sizes and points.
symbols.meaning: Victoria's place in the southern hemisphere.

facts: Victoria was the first Australian colony to use the Southern Cross on its flag.
Its stars have between five and eight points depending on brightness.
clues: A blue ensign with the Southern Cross under a crown.
The first Australian colony to fly the Southern Cross.
Its crown was changed after a coronation in 1953.
